 SARATOGA SPRINGS – Franklin Community Center (FCC) has received the Internal Revenue Service’s (IRS) New Partner of the Year Award, a national honor recognizing excellence, innovation, and an outstanding commitment to serving individuals and families in need through the Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) program, the organization announced in a press release.
